name: oliflow-executor
description: Real backend workflow executor for OliFlow. Runs the node types that don't require third-party OAuth credentials (webhook, http_request, condition, delay, code, set_fields, variables, log, respond_webhook, email via SMTP) for real, and returns an honest 'not implemented' result (never fake success) for node types that still need real third-party API keys. Zero npm dependencies.
